text.p: U.S. stocks opened slightly higher in their first session of 1997 on Thursday, aided by strength in bonds after the release of weekly jobless claims data.
The Dow Jones industrial average gained 19 to 6,467, the Nasdaq Composite was up 0.7 to 1,292 and the S&P Index rose two to 742.8.
The 30-year bond was up 9/32 to yield 6.62 percent.
The number of Americans filing new claims for unemployment benefits rose to 366,000 in the week ended December 28 from a revised 344,000 in the previous week.
